values.meaning: duration of the shield and bonus movement speed

mechanics.claim: Warm Hugs grants a shield and bonus movement speed to Milio or a targeted ally.
mechanics.quote: envelops himself or the target allied champion in protective flames, granting the target a {{tip|shield}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}

mechanics.claim: The ability's effects can stack up to 2 times, and charges are stocked periodically up to a maximum of 2 uses.
mechanics.quote: ''Warm Hugs' effects can stack up to 2 times.''

mechanics.claim: Milio periodically stocks a Warm Hugs charge, up to a maximum of 2, similar to an ammo/charge system rather than a standard cooldown.
mechanics.quote: '''Milio''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Warm Hugs'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
